name: EVA 机械女声
description: Edge TTS（Michelle + Aria 谱形）+ V3 轻柔后处理；39 个事件槽全配语音。
note: sounds 的值是「纯文件名」，由 PresetStore 解析到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\BSH\sounds\；音频不入公开仓库（体积 + 音源授权）。若换台机器没有这些音频，应用时会逐条报缺并跳过。

sounds..Default: （默认应用通用事件）,Generic system event.wav
sounds.AppGPFault: 程序崩溃（一般保护性错误）,Application error. The program has terminated.wav
sounds.ChangeTheme: 切换主题,Theme has been changed.wav
sounds.CriticalBatteryAlarm: 电池电量严重不足,Critical warning. Battery is very low. Connect power now.wav
sounds.DeviceFail: 设备连接失败,Device connection failed.wav
sounds.LowBatteryAlarm: 电池电量低,Warning. Battery level is low.wav
sounds.Notification.Default: 通用通知,You have new information.wav
sounds.Notification.IM: 即时消息,New message. Please respond.wav
sounds.SystemAsterisk: 信息（星号）,Information. A new message has arrived.wav
sounds.SystemExclamation: 警告（感叹号）,Warning. Please check your system.wav
sounds.SystemExit: 退出 Windows,System shutdown. Save your work.wav
sounds.SystemHand: 严重错误（停止）,Critical error. System halted. Save your work.wav
sounds.SystemQuestion: 询问（问号）,Question. Your input is required.wav
sounds.WindowsLogoff: 注销 Windows,Logging off. Session ending now.wav
sounds.WindowsLogon: 登录 Windows,Welcome back. System is ready.wav
sounds.WindowsUAC: 用户账户控制（UAC）,Permission required. Account control.wav
sounds.WindowsUnlock: 解锁 Windows,System unlocked. Welcome back.wav
